messages:
Anya P.: Heads-up: I'm proposing a 'gentle degradation' mode for automatic fallback policies — goal is to reduce hard failovers and give apps a soft landing when models hit errors/latency. Thoughts?
Mike L.: +1 to soft approach. Can we define clear degradations (e.g., reduced tokens, cached response, model downgrade) for each error class?
Priya S.: UX ask — how will this surface in the Console? we need clear telemetry + ability to undo. mini timeline + reason.
Anya P.: Agree. Proposal: policy contains ordered actions with conditions, e.g. {"on_error": ["serve-cached","downgrade-model","rate-limit"]}, with backoff timers and SLA tags.
Sam R.: Important: add sampling for audit logs. We can't log every fallback at 100% or billing explodes. Need trace ids.
Jia W.: Product note: apps should be able to opt-in for 'gentle' vs 'hard' failover per route. Defaults = gentle for low-sensitivity routes.
Nikhil K.: API impact: need to keep response schema stable. If we return cached/downgraded output, include metadata fields: "served_from","fallback_reason","fallback_chain".
Priya S.: Console mock: small badge on route showing current mode, last fallback time, and a quick button to replay last fallback with sample logs.
Anya P.: sample policy snippet:
```
{
  "policy_name": "gentle-default",
  "triggers":{
    "latency_ms": ["p99>1500"],
    "errors": ["model_timeout","kv_miss"]
  },
  "actions": ["serve_kv_cache","reduce_max_tokens","route_to-quantized"],
  "audit_sampling": 0.05
}
```
Mike L.: Implementation concern: ordering and atomicity. If multiple actions are eligible, must ensure idempotent transitions and a visible decision trace.
Sam R.: +1 on decision trace. For SLOs we need per-route histograms and a count of 'gentle' vs 'hard' invocations. Also alert thresholds when fallback rate > X%.
Nikhil K.: Edge case: if cached response is stale, we should attach a TTL and a quality-score so downstream can decide to revalidate.
Jia W.: Can we have a 'canary of canary' — test fallback actions in a safe sandbox to measure quality regression before enabling widely?
Anya P.: Yes — propose rollout phases: simulate -> shadow -> gradual -> enforced. Console should show simulation diffs and evaluation metrics.
ops-bot: Deploy-bot: policy patch applied to staging:gentle-default by @Anya P. at 2026-03-20T15:48Z :white_check_mark:
Priya S.: Final UX ask: provide an audit playback feature — show sequence for a given trace id (requests -> decisions -> actions) for up to 90 days.
Sam R.: We'll need retention and sampling tradeoffs. Ops: what storage budget do we have for 90d at 5% sampling? estimate needed.
Mike L.: I'll prototype decision-trace format and a small in-memory buffer + S3 sink with compressed protobuf. Will post PR.
Anya P.: Thanks everyone — I'll synthesize notes and publish a short RFC. tagging @Jia W. for product review. :rocket:
